evals.name: named-change-in-the-team-language
evals.prompt: explica a proposta reserve-stock-at-checkout pro time
evals.expected_output: A walkthrough of that change. The language is asked or read from .spec-explainer/config.json rather than inferred from the spec, which is English. Six to eight scenes under two minutes, opening on the concrete failure, with everything written under .spec-explainer/ and nothing committed.

evals.name: no-change-named
evals.prompt: make a video of the current change
evals.expected_output: The skill lists what is in flight and asks which change, rather than guessing or defaulting to the most recent. It does not begin writing a storyboard before the change and the language are both settled.

evals.name: different-framework
evals.expected_output: Recognised as spec-kit rather than OpenSpec: the argument is read from spec.md, the decisions from plan.md and research.md, the verification from tasks.md. If plan.md carries no rejected alternative, the skill says the walkthrough will be thin and offers fewer scenes instead of padding to seven.

evals.name: landed-change-quoting-fixed-code
evals.prompt: grava um walkthrough do browser-patience, que já foi mergeado
evals.expected_output: Any code scene quotes the source as it was before the change landed, retrieved with git show <commit>^:<path>, not the current file which already contains the fix and not a reconstruction from the design's prose.
